profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer and Air Force Veteran with 2 years of professional development experience and 6 years leading teams in high-pressure environments. My work spans frontend development, backend data systems, and containerized infrastructure — with hands-on experience developing production ready web applications in secure and air-gapped environments using React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
 
I hold an active TS/SCI clearance and bring a systems-level perspective shaped by managing critical communications infrastructure across multiple installations during my Air Force career. I'm currently pursuing a BS in Software Engineering at Western Governors University, continuously expanding my expertise in scalable software architecture and cloud-native technologies.
 
Outside of work I'm building out a self-hosted private cloud homelab — my hands-on playground for infrastructure, orchestration, and whatever rabbit hole I fall into next. Beyond tech I enjoy astrophotography and nature photography (I took the background photo on my profile!), cooking, gaming, and anything that gets me outside.
 
Feel free to connect if you want to talk software development, hobbies, or anything in between!
